title: The sell sheet with no plans on sale is never opened in a test
what: No test opens Sell membership in a gym with no plans, or with every plan switched off. The owner and desk banners, the missing form and Confirm, and the sheet after a plan is added are never seen. One unit test only checks that the desk words are written in the source file.
expected: A test opens the sheet with no plans as owner and desk, checks each banner and that nothing can be saved, then adds a plan and sells it.
who: owners and front desk of a new gym
how_often: every new gym, before the first plan
fix_line: Add one screen test for the empty sell sheet, owner and desk, then after a plan is added

title: Selling or renewing a PT pack is never done on screen in a test
what: No screen test sells a PT pack. The PT line and its one-session wording, the start jumping to today, the emptied boxes, Renew PT on the PT card, Renew PT hidden for a plan off sale, and a second pack beside the first are checked only as data or not at all.
expected: A screen test sells and renews a PT pack beside a running gym plan, as owner and desk, and checks the words, the dates and the saved pack.
who: owners and front desk selling personal training
fix_line: Add a screen test that sells and renews a PT pack beside a gym plan

title: The UPI QR on the sell sheet is never tested
what: No test shows the UPI QR while selling a plan. Paid by changing to UPI, Received now filling with the total, the QR amount following a typed part amount, and no receipt being made just because the QR is shown are not checked. Only the QR picture builder is tested on its own.
expected: A screen test shows the QR on the sell sheet, checks the method, the amount and the due line, and that no receipt is made until Confirm.
who: owners and front desk taking UPI at the sale
fix_line: Add a screen test for the UPI QR on the sell sheet

title: Many sell sheet hints and error words are never checked
what: No test checks "Charged once, on joining.", the "Last day they can train" line, the hint naming the day the current plan ends, "Leave blank if they will pay later", "Saving…", or the error words for a wrong price, a wrong received amount and a wrong start day. The Sell button inside "No memberships yet" is never tapped. The rules behind the errors are checked only as data.
expected: Screen tests check each hint and each error sentence on the sell sheet, and that the section button opens the same sheet.
fix_line: Add the missing hint and error sentences to the sell sheet screen tests

title: The desk selling with part or no payment, or an old payment date, is never tested
what: Signed in as the desk, no test sells with part of the money, with nothing received, or with a payment date more than 31 days back on the sell sheet. The desk never sees the high-price question in a test. These are checked only as the owner or as data.
expected: A desk screen test sells with part and no payment, checks the due line and Dues, the old payment date refusal on the sell sheet, and the high-price question.
how_often: every desk sale that is not paid in full
fix_line: Extend the desk sell test with part, nothing and old-date payments and the high-price question

title: Cancelling a receipt offline, on failure, or for a non-membership receipt is never tested
what: No test cancels a receipt that is not for a membership, tries to cancel while offline, sees the server refuse a cancel, or checks that a double cancel adds the money to dues only once.
expected: Tests cover the non-membership words, the offline block, the failure banner with the reason still typed, and a double cancel leaving one due change.
how_often: when a receipt is cancelled on bad internet or for a shop or other fee
fix_line: Add tests for the offline, failure and non-membership cancel paths

title: Nothing checks what a member sees of the sale note, dues and cancel reason
what: No test opens the member app after a sale with a note, a part payment or a cancelled receipt, to check that the gym note, the cancel reason, the taker phone number and other members dues stay hidden, and that the due shows in the app own words.
expected: A test reads the member app after these sales and checks what is shown and what stays hidden.
how_often: every sale with a note or a part payment
fix_line: Add a member app check after a sale with a note, a part payment and a cancel

title: No test proves dues of a cancelled plan stop being chased
what: No test cancels a plan that still has money due, or a receipt whose plan is cancelled, and then checks that the member leaves Dues and gets no fee reminder.
expected: A test cancels a part-paid plan and checks Dues and the reminder list leave the member out.
fix_line: Add a test that a cancelled plan drops out of Dues and reminders
